import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; type SchemeTab = 'about' | 'features'; @Component({ selector: 'app-scheme-details', standalone: true, imports: [], templateUrl: './scheme-details.html', styleUrl: './scheme-details.css', }) export class SchemeDetails { readonly activeTab = signal('about'); setTab(tab: SchemeTab): void { this.activeTab.set(tab); } }

Scheme Details

@if (activeTab() === 'about') {
Inception Date 03 Feb 2015
Minimum Investment ₹100 in multiples of ₹1 thereafter
Expense Ratio 1.91%
Exit Load 1%, if redeemed within 90 days
Plans Regular, Direct
Type Open ended dynamic equity scheme – large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks
Options Growth, IDCW (Income Distribution Capital Withdrawal)
Benchmark Nifty 500 TRI
No. of Stocks 85
} @else {

The scheme aims to generate long-term capital appreciation by investing dynamically across large, mid, and small cap companies while managing risk through diversified stock selection.

  • Flexibility to move across market capitalizations based on market conditions
  • Research-driven stock selection with active portfolio management
  • Option to invest via SIP, lump sum, or a combination of both
  • Available under Regular and Direct plans with Growth and IDCW options
}
